description: This file defines the ProductDetailsFragment class, which is an Android UI component responsible for displaying detailed information about a product in an online shopping app. It retrieves product data from the ShopRepository, updates UI elements with product info, and handles navigation actions.

classes.name: ProductDetailsFragment
classes.description: Fragment displaying product details, managing UI components and interactions for a single product.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, retrieving the product ID from arguments.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up UI elements, populates data from the repository, and configures click listeners for buttons.
